title: ImmuCell Corporation Form 8-K - Departure of Directors; Election of Directors
summary: ImmuCell Corporation (ICCC), a small-cap animal health biotechnology company traded on NASDAQ Capital Market, filed this 8-K reporting three board members not standing for re-election at the 2026 Annual Meeting: Bryan K. Gathagan, Michael F. Brigham (former CEO), and Bobbi Jo Brockmann. Two new directors were elected: Dr. Gilles Guillemette (operational expertise at Elanco, Bayer, Henry Schein, Chewy, Trupanion) and Dr. Anthony DiMarco (R&D leadership from IDEXX, Abbott Laboratories). This is a routine corporate governance filing with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Three incumbent directors announced they will not stand for re-election effective April 15, 2026: Bryan K. Gathagan, Michael F. Brigham, and Bobbi Jo Brockmann.
Michael F. Brigham served as President and CEO for more than 25 years (since February 2000) until retirement on November 1, 2025.

Two new directors elected effective April 15, 2026: Dr. Gilles Guillemette (former Elanco, Bayer, Henry Schein executive, Operating Partner at Archimed) and Dr. Anthony DiMarco (former IDEXX VP of R&D and Global Manufacturing for 21 years).
New directors will serve on Board committees including Strategy & Technology Committee, Audit Committee, Compensation, and Nominations committees.
Company trades as ICCC on The NASDAQ Capital Market; no related party transactions requiring disclosure under Item 404(a).
This 8-K was signed by CFO Timothy C. Fiori on April 13, 2026.
